findings.issue: Suffix is 1st common plural (from us); de él is 3rd masculine singular.
Common noun left untranslated as the loanword ómer.
Relative has no gender or number; el que supplies a masculine singular person.
Noun of food with a 3ms suffix is rendered as the verbal noun comer.

notes: 2mp imperative and imperfect match ustedes; Jehová matches the proper name.
